headline: Circle Appoints Ex-Yellow Card Executive to Lead Africa Expansion
summary: Circle has hired former Yellow Card executive Gillian Darko to spearhead its expansion across Africa, aiming to increase stablecoin utility in cross-border payments and remittances.
why: Stablecoin issuers target emerging economies to capture market share in cross-border remittances and alternative digital payment rails.

impacts.name: Circle
impacts.why: Executive appointments focused on emerging markets support strategic geographic expansion for digital assets.
